scope: Investigation only. Production worker unchanged; native/headless image display mocked in Neovim; no Kitty visual acceptance.
harness: Throwaway copies of tests/html/images_regression.lua replaced only the isolated worker path with build/mdview-preview; the second copy additionally inserted the same HTML img into an open details body. Both completed with PASS. Neither harness was retained; independent per-revision native viewport oracle and disk-unchanged checks are in the original test.

native_baseline.fixture: # Before, blank, HTML img, blank, # Following; local solid-color PNGs 160x96, 1200x60, 60x1200; stylesheet styles/markdown.css

details_420.method: One worker LOAD, DRAW, TOGGLE closed/DRAW, TOGGLE open; remove image file after second TOGGLE and before final DRAW. Final DRAW still produced the same raster. This proves no file re-read for that DRAW, not an instrumented decoder-call count on every path.

native_baseline.height_only: One LOAD at width 420 followed by 420x400 and 420x600 DRAWs: one READY, two FRAMEs, first 400 RGBA rows pixel-equal, unchanged following-heading FRAG y=1322.2.

attribute_policy_now.cases: 2 extreme PNGs x 3 widths x 5 accepted attribute combinations (width=120; height=120; both 120; width=2000 height=30; width=-1 height=5%)
attribute_policy_now.result: All 30 PNG byte hashes, following-heading FRAGs and READY heights matched each corresponding no-attribute baseline exactly. Attributes are discarded, not validated. Duplicate width attributes instead produced a malformed-img diagnostic and literal fallback in all six extreme/width combinations, not image sizing.
attribute_policy_now.intrinsic_guard: 8193x1 PNG with width=1 height=1 rejected at line 3:1 as intrinsic image dimensions exceed pixel safety budget; missing source likewise produced a localized diagnostic.

css_experiment.method: Author-controlled CSS appended to stock stylesheet, production worker LOAD/DRAW. Not user HTML attribute support. Solid-color exact RGB image bbox extracted from PNG, 1600px-tall draw clips taller image; following-heading FRAG independent of pixel-box detection.
css_experiment.interpretation: CSS width/height independently can stretch or distort, and max-height did not cap the tall case in this renderer. Visible wide-image box reaches the viewport edge even though .markdown-body has 48px horizontal padding; do not assume content width from CSS alone. These CSS observations do not prove a future computed-size implementation.

pending: Computed aspect-preserving size contract and parser are not implemented
No chosen fixed vertical cap; high-aspect case demonstrates need to decide whether to cap requested size
